{
  "job_id": "TEST-FAILOVER-CLOTHING-005",
  "department": "CHARACTER",
  "status": "PASS",
  "character_decisions": {
    "character": "Inaria",
    "identity": "Preserve the established canonical Inaria identity without modification.",
    "face": "Keep the established facial structure, features, skin tone, expression range, and facial consistency unchanged.",
    "hair": "Keep the established hairstyle, hair color, texture, length, and hairline unchanged.",
    "body": "Maintain established believable body proportions, anatomy, stature, and silhouette.",
    "age_version": "Use the established Inaria age and character version; do not age, de-age, redesign, or reinterpret.",
    "stable_summer_outfit": {
      "top": "Lightweight, opaque, fitted short-sleeve summer blouse in a restrained neutral or established palette.",
      "bottom": "High-waisted, knee-length tailored shorts or a simple knee-length skirt with believable construction and coverage.",
      "footwear": "Simple low-profile summer shoes or sandals with secure straps and anatomically plausible foot placement.",
      "accessories": "Minimal accessories only if already consistent with Inaria's established design; avoid identity-defining additions.",
      "materials": "Breathable cotton, linen, or similarly stable fabrics with simple folds and low visual complexity.",
      "fit": "Comfortable, non-distorting fit that preserves the canonical body silhouette and supports reliable generation."
    },
    "pose_and_scene": "Use a neutral, anatomically stable standing or relaxed walking pose in a simple summer setting; these choices are temporary and must not redefine Inaria."
  },
  "locked_constraints": [
    "Preserve the established Inaria identity exactly.",
    "Do not alter canonical facial features, hair identity, skin tone, age, body proportions, or recognizable silhouette.",
    "Prioritize facial consistency, believable anatomy, proportional hands and feet, and generation reliability.",
    "Clothing must not change perceived age, gender presentation, body structure, or character identity.",
    "Do not introduce permanent design elements through temporary clothing, accessories, pose, lighting, or scene.",
    "Maintain consistent character versioning across outputs."
  ],
  "intentional_variations": [
    "Summer clothing color may vary within the established Inaria palette.",
    "Fabric texture, minor garment folds, and neutral summer styling may vary.",
    "Pose, camera framing, lighting, and background may vary for dataset coverage while preserving identity.",
    "Accessories may be omitted or varied only when they are not part of the locked canonical design."
  ],
  "notes": [
    "Identity constraints take priority over clothing styling.",
    "Keep the outfit simple, opaque, seasonally appropriate, and free of complex patterns or unstable layered details.",
    "If canonical reference details conflict with this clothing specification, retain the canonical identity and adapt the outfit rather than modifying Inaria."
  ]
}
